property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the AdjustLayoutPreference (a Document).

property.name: enableAdjustLayout
property.shortdesc: If true, adjust layout is enabled.

property.name: allowLockedObjectsToAdjust
property.shortdesc: If true, allows locked objects or objects on locked layers to be adjusted.

property.name: allowFontSizeAndLeadingAdjustment
property.shortdesc: If true, allows font sizes and leading to adjust.

property.name: imposeFontSizeRestriction
property.shortdesc: If true, imposes the font size restriction during the adjustment.

property.name: minimumFontSize
property.shortdesc: minimum font size after adjustment in points

property.name: maximumFontSize
property.shortdesc: maximum font size after adjustment in points

property.name: enableAutoAdjustMargins
property.shortdesc: If true, margins are adjusted automatically if page size is changed.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the AdjustLayoutPreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
